name: jobId
label: Job ID
help: The job ID returned by Start a price job. Results stay available for about 1 hour after the job finishes.

name: skipEmpty
label: Skip queries without offers
help: By default every query returns a bundle, including queries that were not found or failed (see Status and Error code). Turn on to return only queries that have at least one offer.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of bundles to return. Leave empty to return one bundle per query.
